subject: Brand and Communications Intern: pay range, burden and monthly cost

items.label: Recommended hourly rate, low end
items.source: Docket's pick from the market table in projects/comms/intern-legal-and-pay.md s.3 (judgement figure; confirm it sits at or above the Boise MSA entry wages for 13-1161 and below 27-3031 plus one dollar, and above the WA 2027 minimum)
items.note: Above WA 2027 min 17.73 (L&I 26-17). Boise 13-1161 entry wage and 27-3031+1 bounds NOT verified: BLS API rate-limited, OEWS pages not readable. Docket to confirm.

items.label: Recommended hourly rate, high end
items.source: Docket's pick, s.3 and s.5 (ceiling for a portfolio-ready graduate); judgement figure, check it is below the Schweitzer posting floor and the NACE bachelor's average
items.note: Below NACE bachelor's avg 23.35 and SEL Boise posting floor 21.50; an older SEL posting floored at 18.00, so Docket should name which posting.

items.label: Idaho minimum wage, adult
items.source: Idaho Code 44-1502(1), current text on legislature.idaho.gov

items.label: Idaho UI new-employer rate 2026
items.source: Governor's press release 17 Dec 2025, gov.idaho.gov 'Idaho businesses see another $11 million in tax savings'; or IDOL Unemployment Tax Rates page

items.label: Idaho UI taxable wage base 2026
items.source: Same governor's release, 17 Dec 2025

items.label: FUTA net rate
items.source: IRS Form 940 instructions / Pub. 15, net rate after full state credit, no credit reduction

items.label: FUTA wage base
Employer Social Security plus Medicare
items.source: IRS Pub. 15 (2026), employer share of OASDI plus HI

items.label: Idaho WC rate class 8742 per $100 payroll
items.source: Idaho Industrial Commission 'Idaho Workers Compensation Rates effective Jan 1, 2026' PDF (iic.idaho.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rates2026-1.pdf), class 8742 NCCI rate
items.note: IIC Rates2026 PDF 8742 = 0.220 per $100 = 0.22%. Note 8810 clerical is 0.117; confirm class assignment

items.label: Idaho WC rate class 8810 per $100 payroll
items.source: Same IIC 2026 rates PDF, class 8810

items.label: Total employer burden used
items.source: Sum of employer FICA, FUTA net rate, Idaho UI new-employer rate and WC class 8742 rate (all four items above), applied to all wages; FUTA and UI caps not reached in a month

items.label: Monthly wages, 10 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Low-end hourly rate x 10 x 52 / 12, rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total cost, 10 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Monthly wages at 10 hrs plus total burden % x those wages (burden rounded to the cent)

items.label: Monthly wages, 15 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Low-end hourly rate x 15 x 52 / 12

items.label: Monthly burden, 15 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Total burden % x monthly wages at 15 hrs, rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total cost, 15 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Monthly wages plus burden at 15 hrs

items.label: Monthly total cost, 20 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Low-end rate x 20 x 52 / 12, plus total burden % on it, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total cost, 15 hrs/wk at $17
items.source: $17 x 15 x 52 / 12 plus total burden % on it

items.label: Monthly total cost, 15 hrs/wk at high-end rate
items.source: High-end hourly rate x 15 x 52 / 12 plus total burden % on it

items.label: Annual employer cost, 15 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Wages = rate x 15 x 52; plus FICA on all wages, FUTA net rate on first FUTA wage base only, Idaho UI on all wages (under the UI base), WC 8742 on all wages; each component rounded to the cent

items.label: Average monthly cost, 15 hrs/wk at low-end rate
items.source: Annual employer cost above / 12

items.label: Idaho new-hire report deadline
items.source: labor.idaho.gov Report New Hires page (days from hire date)

ask: Kev: pick the starting rate (Docket recommends the low end), weekly hours, and Idaho-only work
